name: ReplySeal
author: replyseal

sections.description:
ReplySeal is an AI SEO tool that grows your traffic from Google and ChatGPT on
autopilot. Every day it writes a new article around what your customers search
for, and this plugin publishes it on your blog.

What you get

  • A new, optimized article on your blog every day
  • Articles written to rank on Google and to be quoted by ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity
  • Drafts by default, automatic publishing when you switch it on
  • Your articles stay current: ReplySeal can update the posts it published

Built to stay out of your way

  • Connects in 2 minutes, with one button and no password to copy
  • Works with blog posts only: your pages, users, settings and theme stay as they are
  • Adds no script and no stylesheet to your public pages
  • Every incoming article is cleaned with wp_kses_post, so no script or iframe gets in

Why a plugin rather than an application password

Application passwords are switched off by many security plugins and managed
hosts, and they carry every capability of the user who creates them. The
ReplySeal plugin has its own route and its own key, scoped to blog posts, so
the connection works on every site.

Third party service

The plugin connects your site to ReplySeal, the service that writes your
articles. A ReplySeal account is required; your first 3 days are free.

  • Service: https://replyseal-ai.com
  • Terms: https://replyseal-ai.com/legal/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://replyseal-ai.com/legal/privacy

Privacy

At connection time, and only then, the plugin sends replyseal-ai.com: your site
address, its name, your WordPress version, and a key generated on your server.
No personal data, no content, no analytics.

After that, replyseal-ai.com calls your site to deposit an article. The plugin
never sends anything on its own again.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. It connects to your ReplySeal account by itself. That is all.

If the connection does not finish, open Settings, ReplySeal, and click “Connect to ReplySeal”.
sections.faq:
Do I need a ReplySeal account?

Yes. The plugin publishes the articles ReplySeal writes for you. Create your
account on replyseal-ai.com: your first 3 days are free.

Are my articles published straight away?

Not unless you ask for it. By default they arrive as drafts and you publish
them. Automatic publishing is switched on from your ReplySeal account.

What data leaves my site?

At connection time only: the site address, its name, your WordPress version and
a key generated on your own server. Nothing else.

What can the connection key do?

Blog posts only: it can create, update, list and trash them. Your pages, users
and settings are out of its reach. Reconnecting the site replaces the key.

How do I disconnect my site?

Delete the plugin: the key is removed from your database and the connection
stops working. Deactivating the plugin pauses publishing without deleting the
key, so you can switch it back on without starting over.

Does the plugin slow my site down?

No. It adds no script, no stylesheet and no query to your public pages. It only
does something when an article arrives.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

  • Articles reuse your site’s own categories when one fits, and can carry tags, an excerpt, a featured image and their SEO title and description (Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress).
  • Polylang: articles are filed in their language.

1.3.0

  • Articles arrive in a category of their own instead of “Uncategorized”. The category is created on your site the first time it is used.

1.2.0

  • The site connects to ReplySeal right after activation: no settings page, no extra button.

1.1.0

  • ReplySeal can now update, delete (to the trash) and list blog posts, so it can
    keep the articles it manages current. Still posts only: no pages, users or
    settings.

1.0.1

  • The plugin and its directory page are now in English, so they read the same
    way for everyone who finds it here. French and other languages come from the
    WordPress translation platform.

1.0.0

  • First release.
